idle.prompt: A soldier stands alert holding a rifle at the ready, slightly shifting weight and looking around

walk.prompt: A soldier walks forward carefully holding a rifle at the chest

run.prompt: A soldier runs forward fast holding a rifle

crouch.prompt: A soldier crouches low behind cover holding a rifle, staying almost still and watching

crouch_walk.prompt: A soldier moves forward in a low crouch holding a rifle with careful sneaking steps

look.prompt: A soldier looks left and right suspiciously, searching the area while holding a rifle

hit.prompt: A soldier is hit in the body and flinches, stumbling

die1.prompt: A soldier is shot in the chest and falls backward to the ground dead

die2.prompt: A soldier is shot, drops to his knees and falls forward face down

die3.prompt: A soldier is shot in the head and collapses straight down limp

throw.prompt: A soldier pulls a grenade and throws it overhand forward

flinch.prompt: A soldier ducks quickly covering his head with his arm

grabbed.prompt: A soldier is grabbed from behind, struggles briefly then goes limp and drops

stagger.prompt: A soldier is blinded by a bright flash, covers his eyes and stumbles around
